title: Five front pages, 1996 to 2019
lede: Screenshots of compusa.com as the Internet Archive’s Wayback Machine saved it, stored as images. Click one to open the original capture.[^26]
note: A capture from February 2007, the week of the store-closing announcement, rendered as a blank page and is not shown.

captures.label: The virtual store
captures.title: CompUSA Online
captures.text: A navigation wheel for sales, tech services, training and store locations, with buttons recommending Internet Explorer and Netscape. A notice at the top says the old site “will be going down soon.”

captures.label: Three companies
captures.title: The week the buyout closed
captures.text: A splash page sending visitors to cozone.com, CompUSA PC or the stores, with a note that the three were “separate web sites.” The tender offer had expired two days earlier.[^6] Cropped to the page content.

captures.label: After the cuts
captures.title: After the closings
captures.text: The site three and a half months after the announcement that 126 stores would close.[^12]
captures.warn: The main banner image was not archived and renders as a color block.

captures.label: New owner
captures.title: “Welcome to the all-new CompUSA.com”
captures.text: Three days after Systemax completed its purchase of the web business.[^17]

captures.label: The deals site
captures.title: “Powered by DealCentral”
captures.text: The old logo over a page of deal categories and links to other stores.[^21]
